what: Skip condition treats present-but-not-executable check scripts the same as missing scripts
scenario_or_breakage: A consumer adds scripts/relevant-checks.sh but loses the executable bit; /implement and /review silently skip local validation instead of surfacing a bad migration
suggested_fix: Split the wrapper branch: only emit RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED when the file is absent; emit STATUS=fail FAILURE_REASON=check-script-not-executable for present non-executable or non-regular files, and add harness cases for both

what: The final grep gate conflicts with the intended new scripts/relevant-checks.sh references
